title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Municipality of Lakewood, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Be Known as the Bag-ong Kahayag High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Municipality of Lakewood, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Be Known as the Bag-ong Kahayag High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Thị trấn Lakewood, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Bag-ong Kahayag
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Bag-ong Kahayag, เทศบาล Lakewood, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bag-ong Kahayag
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Kotamadya Lakewood, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Bag-ong Kahayag
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Perbandaran Lakewood, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Bag-ong Kahayag

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Bag-ong Kahayag, Municipality of Lakewood, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, to be known as the Bag-ong Kahayag High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
